settings.candidate_status: unverified rounded report value; not a source correction

scenarios.report_candidate: change only the candidate cell in a copy, n=10
scenarios.omit_p01: omit P01 from all three tables, n=9

settings.icc: ICC(1,1), finite complete rows, 95% F interval
settings.correlations: Spearman; BH across all 36 unique pairs per scenario
settings.omnibus: Friedman; Holm across all three metrics per scenario
settings.paired: two-sided Wilcoxon; Holm across all nine session pairs per scenario
settings.change_intervals: paired t 95% intervals in source units; d_z uses difference SD
settings.limits: Sensitivity only; original export and verified NN-beat provenance unavailable
